title: Romancing Salasaria: The Bride of the Desert and the Lamp of Wonders Episode Preview

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: I didn't think Father's request would be an errand to the desert country... It's going to be an unexpected trip.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お父さまの頼みが、
まさか砂漠の国へのおつかいとはね……
予想外の旅に
なりそうだわ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Well, it's more fun to travel with people, isn't it? It's so hot, but you don't often go to faraway countries.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
旅は道連れ、
賑やかな方が楽しいだろ？
この暑さには参っちまうけど、
遠い国に行くことなんて
そうそうないからね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Yes... I was told I could do whatever I wanted once I finished what I came here for. Since we're on a trip, I'll have to enjoy it♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ……
用事を済ませれば
あとは自由にしていいって言われたし。
せっかくの旅行だもの、
堪能しなくちゃね♪

text_block_list.name: Saren & Ruka
text_block_list.text: It's our honeymoon, after all. It'll be our honeymaon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしたちの新婚旅行、ですもの。
アタシたちの新婚旅行、だからね。

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Next time, 'The Romancing Salasaria: The Bride of the Desert and the Lamp of Wonders'
text_block_list.orig_text:
次回
『ロマンシング・サラサリア　
～砂漠の花嫁と
不思議のランプ～』

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうわけで
旦那さま♪

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Make sure you act like a proper husband. After all, we're family...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃんと亭主らしく振る舞っておくれよ。
なんたって
アタシたちは家族……
なんだからさ♪
